simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to סֶלַע (H5554) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: סֶלַע (Çelaʻ) means Sela , the rock-city of Idumaea First listed occurrence: 2Kgs 14 7.

definitions.full: H5554. Sela II. סֶ֫לַע proper name, of a location in Edom , ׳מֵהַהַסּ Judg 1:36 (strike out מֵ , compare GFM); ׳הַסּ captured in war 2Kin 14:7 (and called יָקְתְאֵל ); ׳מִסּ Isa 16:1 ; site dubious; old identification with Petra denied, plausibly, by Buhl Edom GFM Ju, 36 (who thinks of an actual cliff ), but held Benz 2Kin 14:7 Bd Pal (1898), 206 ; ᵐ5 ( ἡ ) πέτρα .
